evidence: Modifies files under src/test/fuzz, introduces an include-guard linter, and configures CI to enforce IWYU rules for fuzz targets.
rationale: Enforcing IWYU rules and cleaning up transitive headers in fuzz targets is internal test code hygiene with no impact on test signal, bug detection, or coverage. While it stops header creep by adding CI checks and a linter, test code cleanliness ranks lowest in the category and has no pressing claim on review attention.
